page.notes: Two-column index with verse numerals to the left of each entry. Several printed numerals and abbreviations are uncertain (e.g. "Quisquis relinquit", "Ego dispono", "propheta") and are given as printed in the scan; the marginal numerals belong to their entries. Some lines near the page foot and the header "INDEX" were read from the scan; the page is a column index, not a text page.
